subject: Full-loop day: split-day proposal + candidate availability
content:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Choi <alex.cho@gmail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 Nov 2024 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Full-loop day: split-day proposal + candidate availability

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. Before we lock calendars I wanted to propose a split-day approach for your virtual onsite to keep cognitive load lower while still getting the full loop in. High level:

- Option A (compact full day): 4 x 45–50m panels back-to-back (short lunch) — ends up ~4.5h total
- Option B (split day): 2 panels in the morning (4h with breaks), lunch / async coding exercise, then 2 panels + debrief next morning (2.5h) — reduces continuous stretch and gives you time to work on the exercise if you want

Please see the attached "candidate_prefs.pdf" (your timezone + stated windows) and the draft schedule CSV attached (proposed_split_day_schedule.csv). We can run the loop either Tue Nov 26 (compact) or Wed Nov 27 + Thu Nov 28 (split).

Can you reply with your preferred option + any hard constraints? Also let us know if you prefer synchronous coding (live paired) or take-home with a 2-hour window between panels.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: candidate_prefs.pdf (application/pdf)]

-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Choi <alex.cho@gmail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Nov 2024 18:09:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Full-loop day: split-day proposal + candidate availability

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — I prefer Option B (split day). I do better with a midday break, and I have a deadline at my current job on Nov 27 afternoon so having the second half on Nov 28 works better.

I’d prefer a take-home coding exercise (2-hour window same afternoon after the morning panels) rather than live pairing. Also I’m in EST (UTC-05:00) — earliest start I can do is 9:30 AM my time.

Appreciate it,
Alex

-----Original Message-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Choi <alex.cho@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Nov 2024 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Full-loop day: split-day proposal + candidate availability

Team — Alex prefers the split-day flow: morning panels on Wed Nov 27, take-home 2-hour window midday, then the remaining panels + debrief on Thu Nov 28 morning. Candidate is EST and earliest start 9:30 AM EST.

Please confirm:
- Morning panels on Nov 27 should start no earlier than 9:30 AM EST (12:30 PM PST).
- For continuity, Laura suggested moving System Design to the morning so the API/implementation panel can follow the exercise on Thu AM.
- We want a short 20–30m evaluator buffer before the debrief to let interviewers gather notes.

I've attached a draft we can iterate on: proposed_split_day_schedule.csv and a current interview rubric (interview_rubric_v2.md).

[Attachment: proposed_split_day_schedule.csv (text/csv)]
[Attachment: interview_rubric_v2.md (text/markdown)]

Thanks — please reply with availability or proposed swaps by EOD so I can send calendar invites by tomorrow.

— Priyom
